decisions.reason: Floor cleaning soap is a low-cost complementary accessory to the firm's wood floors, and with only one year of evidence its value is still uncertain, so keeping the option open is cheap.
Maintenance oil complements oiled parquet and costs little to keep listed, so the firm keeps the option open while demand is still uncertain.
This care product overlaps somewhat with the cleaning soap and maintenance oil, but it is cheap to keep, so the firm keeps it for now and can prune later if results disappoint.
A moisture-protection underlay is a natural add-on for floor installations with low holding cost, and one year has not shown that its value is unlikely, so it stays.
This high-density underlay is a second underlay variant with some overlap, but trading or stocking it costs little, so the option stays open until sales data clarify its value.
Oak parquet is close to the firm's core wood business and carries the strategic value of the whole range, so with uncertainty still unresolved the firm keeps investing in it.
